name: Welcome to The Long Game
text: Welcome to The Long Game! Techs have Insights: do something related and that tech becomes 33% cheaper to research (see each tech's description). Quarters are districts whose tile yields without a worker. Each era you choose a permanent Legacy. Wars build War Weariness, and outgrowing your rivals builds Imperial Strain. Full guide: Civilopedia, Tutorials, The Long Game.

name: About Imperial Strain
text: Our empire now has more cities than our rivals can match: Imperial Strain (top bar). Each point makes technologies 4% and policies 5% more expensive and adds unhappiness from the number of cities. It falls as rivals grow. We can still expand, with diminishing returns.

name: About War Weariness
text: Our people are tiring of war: War Weariness (top bar). It grows every turn at war and with every unit or city lost. Every 5 points add 5% unhappiness from population. It falls in peace, and making peace halves it.
